selection: Matched16 configurations in each view, identical outerLOSO/inner4 hashed source folds. Rank inner source-weightedMAE,RMSE,configID. Per-view oneSE family mean; winnerSE=sampleSD(per-source innerMAE)/sqrt(G). Joint32-view winner/oneSE recorded as secondary only. Never replace primary with highest outer score.
generalization: At least10 development source families and genuinely new untouched external-source validation; reuse of these development sources alone never achieves reliable-model acceptance.
input_scope: Same10%/20%,minimum3 actual early points. Four approved shape fields only if>=3 actual points in each temporal half. No interpolation, no deleting missing-shape rows. Train-only Encoder drops unsupported fields or imputes median with missing indicators.
cohort_design: 3E unchanged exact30/24 and20/19; reuse3440 archived six-control fit predictions. New2E localRPPAC expands7/7 and5/5, requiring both views to fit on the same expanded2E data. Data expansion is not attributed to shape features.
no_failure_dropping: All failures and warnings retained. Any incomplete coverage fails acceptance.
secondary: Per-family/view results,near4 equal,and joint view selection. Paired-source MAE difference bootstrap. P6 nonlinear/BP histories and A direct route preserved, not rerun for this feature-isolation comparison.
stop: Exactly5360 new estimator fits;3440 prior control fits reused,0 learned ensemble weights. No outcome-driven additions.
